stop_reason: The researcher explicitly stopped further finite-size acquisition and requested a thermodynamic theory, hypotheses, and proof program. Do not run the L13 preflight, production, or MPS optimization under this contract. Completed validation remains valid provenance.
authorization: Continuation of the researcher-authorized boundary-focused intrinsic-decoding study after the separately registered boundary-MPS validation passed.

program_alignment.central_question: Does the full-charge optimal posterior keep hardening beyond L=11 in the directed boundary window, or does low-gap mass approach a finite-size floor?
program_alignment.scientific_layer: decoder-independent intrinsic recoverability and transition diagnostics
program_alignment.epistemic_role: claim-bounded finite-size acquisition, not a threshold or thermodynamic study
program_alignment.information_value: One new size directly tests the direction of the registered fixed-gap observables after exact frontier tables became infeasible and the approximate posterior was independently validated.

question: At p=0.30 and q in {0.90,0.94,0.97}, do L13 Bayes risk, fixed-gap CDFs, gap quantiles and low-gap risk shares continue the L7--L11 outward motion, flatten, or show tail takeover?

competing_outcomes.continued_contraction: R_L and C_L(1) decrease from L11 to L13 while the median and lower-quartile gap move outward, with B_L(1) not increasing.
competing_outcomes.finite_size_plateau: L13-minus-L11 contrasts are unresolved or near zero jointly across risk, CDF and gap quantiles.
competing_outcomes.low_gap_tail_takeover: Typical gaps move outward and C_L(1) falls, but B_L(1) increases, concentrating remaining risk in low-gap records.
competing_outcomes.censored: Resource, integrity, precision or numerical-sensitivity gates fail; no mechanism interpretation is promoted.

claim_boundary: This contract may report one finite-size L13 extension and its registered L11 contrasts. It cannot estimate qc, fit a crossing or threshold, infer an exponent/universality/BKT class, establish a thermodynamic phase, or add L15 or any new p/q value.

research_basis.method_boundary: The source provides an MPS contraction template; accuracy for this ternary-current posterior is supplied only by the completed L5/L7 exact-ceiling and L9/L11 recordwise validation.

physical_contract.observation: full physical charge record Q only
physical_contract.hidden_information: physical current, activity mask, orientation uniforms and true logical sector are unavailable to the posterior evaluator
physical_contract.target: normalized two-logical-sector posterior Z0(Q),Z1(Q), Bayes risk and absolute posterior gap
physical_contract.independent_unit: one independently generated L13 physical current and its full measured charge record

inference_contract.sensitivity_indices: sample_index modulo 8 equals 0; fixed before generation and evaluated for every q
inference_contract.posterior_interface: charge, p, q and public lattice geometry only

matched_sampling.coupling: For every sample_index, q=.90,.94,.97 share the same activity uniforms and orientation uniforms; q changes only the registered orientation threshold.
matched_sampling.across_size_relation: L13 is independent of the completed L11 streams; L13-minus-L11 contrasts use independent two-sample uncertainty and are never called paired.
matched_sampling.record_key: L13 stream seed, sample index and q; every current/charge hash must be unique within its cell and replayable from the frozen stream.

acquisition.synchronized_stop: Generate a common full batch for all three q values and stop only when every cell passes both precision targets or all reach the hard cap.

secondary: median and lower quartile of abs(DeltaF)

uncertainty.L13_q_contrasts: matched sample-index bootstrap over the shared latent stream
uncertainty.L13_minus_L11: independent two-sample record bootstrap using the completed L11 cells

numerical_sensitivity_gates.comparisons: On the fixed modulo-8 subset, compare chi16 versus chi32 within each sweep and left versus right at chi32.
numerical_sensitivity_gates.failure_action: Censor all L13 scientific estimates; do not increase chi, relax gates, select records post hoc or promote one sweep.

preflight_gate.operation: Without production histories, evaluate zero-current and deterministic seeded L13 charge records at chi16/chi32 in both sweeps; verify charge-only inputs, normalization, nonnegativity, risk-gap, sector-swap, action blindness, replay and registered resource caps.
preflight_gate.failure_action: Close censored and do not generate production histories.

integrity_gates: Every posterior is finite, nonnegative and normalized; record risk equals 1/(1+exp(abs(DeltaF))) to 1e-10.
The evaluator receives no current, activity/orientation uniform or true-sector field.
All record keys and charge hashes replay from the frozen stream and no record is reused across q as an independent unit.
The preflight, numerical-sensitivity, record-count, precision/censoring, runtime and memory gates are reported before mechanism interpretation.

analysis_rule.matrix: Append L13 estimates to the completed q=.90/.94/.97 L7/L9/L11 summaries without pooling raw records across sizes.
analysis_rule.mechanism_assessment: Report all primary and secondary observables together; no single trend or selected q may decide the mechanism.
analysis_rule.promotion_rule: Only if preflight, production integrity and all numerical-sensitivity gates pass may the analysis state which finite-size mechanism is favored through L13.

acceptance_criteria: The zero-history L13 preflight passes all public-interface, numerical identity, replay and resource gates before production is armed.
All three q cells share the frozen latent stream, reach 384 records and either all pass both precision targets or synchronously stop at 768 with censoring explicit.
At least 48 fixed sensitivity records per cell pass every chi and sweep gate before any L13 mechanism statement.
The complete L7/L9/L11/L13 summary reports risk, fixed-gap CDFs, gap quantiles and low-gap risk shares with the registered independent/matched uncertainty and no threshold claim.
The machine-readable outputs, Local Wiki evidence boundary, concise report statement, active registry and rendered delivery surface agree.
stop_rule: Run the zero-history preflight first. If it passes, acquire only the three synchronized L13 cells in 128-record batches and stop at joint precision or the hard cap. Do not add sizes, p/q points, chi values, records beyond cap, decoder comparisons, threshold fits or thermodynamic interpretations.

post_registration_change_log.trigger: The first L13 timing evidence exposed that the registered 12-evaluation preflight cap did not imply feasibility of the minimum production matrix.
post_registration_change_log.effect: Production arming is withdrawn before any histories. The physical, observation, inference, sampling, sensitivity and scientific analysis contracts are unchanged.
post_registration_change_log.remediation: A semantics-preserving implementation must replay the 12 posteriors to 1e-10 and project the unchanged minimum matrix within 7200 seconds on four workers.

post_registration_change_log.effect: Neither candidate is an engineering-equivalent replacement. Production remains unarmed with zero histories.
post_registration_change_log.next_gate: Treat the fast row-boundary schedule only as a new approximate method and preregister a fresh unused exact-control validation before it can replace the validated vertex schedule.

post_registration_change_log.trigger: Registration of the row-boundary schedule as a scientifically distinct approximation
post_registration_change_log.effect: A single-use exact L9/L11 validation is frozen in advance: exclude all 96 prior validation records, select 48 fresh records, and test chi16/32 in both sweeps under exact gap, risk, cutoff and risk-share gates.

production_blocker: Researcher stopped the finite-size acquisition route on 2026-09-22. No further preflight or production without a new purpose explicitly tied to the theory program.

amendments.change: Promote row truncation only; preserve p/q/L, chi, sweeps, sampling, precision, sensitivity and resource caps.
